name: JJ Rhatigan & Company
desc: Family-run Irish main building contractor, founded 1952, delivering education, healthcare, commercial and industrial projects in Ireland and the UK.
customers: public bodies (education, healthcare, Garda), commercial and industrial clients
markets: Ireland and the United Kingdom, with a new UK headquarters in central London opened February 2026

signals.what: Opened new UK headquarters in central London
Started construction of Macroom Garda Divisional Headquarters

name: ACN
desc: Direct-selling company, founded 1993, marketing internet, energy and wireless services through independent business owners in North America and Europe.
products: internet, energy, wireless and home services resold via independent business owners
markets: United States and Canada, plus an EU customer section; Wikipedia cites 26-27 countries as of 2019 (partly unverified)

alt_indicators.evidence: US, Canada and EU customer sites; 26-27 countries as of 2019 per Wikipedia

fit_rationale: Consumer reseller of telecom and energy whose IBO recruitment events could use F1 imagery, but the Clay bracket is implausible, reported revenue is old, and MLM reputation risk is high.
compliance: Network-marketing model: site discloses IBOs may lose money; named in Doe v. Trump Corp. class action, dismissed Jan 2024 with leave to refile in state courts (Wikipedia).

name: TEPCO Energy Partner
aliases: 東京電力エナジーパートナー
desc: Retail electricity and gas supplier of the TEPCO group, buying power from generators and selling it to households and businesses in Japan.
products: retail electricity, city gas, energy services
markets: Japan, chiefly the Tokyo metropolitan area and nationwide retail since market liberalisation

fin.value_orig: JPY 4,914,222m (4兆9142億2200万円), FY to March 2026
fin.source: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/東京電力エナジーパートナー

profitability_basis: Operating profit JPY 229.12bn in FY to March 2026 (ja.wikipedia)
fit_rationale: Huge domestic energy retailer competing for Japanese households after liberalisation; only the Suzuka race fits its market, and the energy category already has several F1 partners.
category_conflict: potential: energy companies already in F1 (e.g. Shell with Ferrari, Petronas with Mercedes, Aramco)
compliance: 2023: METI reported staff improperly viewing renewable generators' customer data (ja.wikipedia).
outstanding: employees; recent newsroom (tepco.co.jp returned 403); marketing autonomy from TEPCO HD
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/東京電力エナジーパートナー

name: VerSe Innovation (Dailyhunt)
desc: Indian local-language content technology company behind the Dailyhunt news aggregator and Josh short-video app, plus Magzter and Valueleaf.
products: Dailyhunt, Josh, Magzter digital magazines, Valueleaf ad-tech
customers: Indian consumers (300M+ users per company) and advertisers
minority_investors: CPPIB, Siguler Guff, Sequoia Capital India, Falcon Edge, Matrix Partners India, Omidyar Network, Goldman Sachs, Sofina, ByteDance; Google-backed per Reuters headline
markets: India, with Magzter digital magazines sold internationally

fin.value_orig: about USD 5bn (April 2022 round led by CPPIB)

profitability_basis: EBITDA break-even targeted by end FY25 (Business Standard headline, Aug 2024); no result stated

signals.what: Appointed P.R. Ramesh independent director and audit committee chair, a governance step consistent with IPO preparation
Named a Chief Product and Technology Officer for AI-led innovation

fit_rationale: Large Indian consumer media platform with past IPL and Manchester City tie-ins; F1 content and co-marketing could drive engagement, but India has no Grand Prix and B2B value is low.

access.roles: Co-founder; Chief Marketing Officer; Head of Brand Partnerships

outstanding: current valuation and revenue; profitability; marketing head

name: NNPC Limited
subsector: national oil company and fuel retail
desc: Nigeria's state-owned national oil company, incorporated as a limited liability company in 2022, spanning upstream production, gas and fuel retail.
products: crude oil, gas, refined products, NNPC retail fuel stations
customers: oil buyers, gas offtakers, Nigerian motorists via retail stations
markets: Nigeria upstream and downstream, with crude and gas sold internationally

signals.what: President dissolved the board; Bayo Ojulari appointed Group CEO
Won a global branding award for petroleum retail excellence
Agreement with the Central Bank of Nigeria to enhance energy financing

fit_rationale: State oil major with a branded retail network and international crude and gas buyers; F1 could support the retail brand and partner hospitality, but fuel is a crowded F1 category and governance risk is material.
category_conflict: potential: fuel and energy partners already in F1 (Shell, Petronas, Aramco and others)

access.roles: Group CEO; Chief Corporate Communications Officer; Head of Retail Marketing

compliance: State oil company in a high-risk governance environment; board dissolved by presidential order in April 2025; Nov 2026 press statement on Duke Oil cargoes accounting. Needs compliance review.
outstanding: recent audited revenue and profit; retail station count; marketing head
